description: Append rows of data after the last row with data in a range

includeValuesInResponse.description: Whether to include the appended values in the response

insertDataOption.description: How to handle existing data: OVERWRITE writes over existing, INSERT_ROWS inserts new rows

range.description: The A1 notation of a range to search for data. Data will be appended after the last row with data in this range (e.g., "Sheet1!A:A" to append to column A, or "Sheet1" to append to the sheet)

valueInputOption.description: How input data should be interpreted: RAW (as-is) or USER_ENTERED (parsed like typed in UI)

values.description: The data to append, as a 2D array of values (rows of columns)

name: values_append
title: Append values
